description: The file defines a Java class 'ProductList' that is designed to hold a collection of 'ReadableProduct' objects along with a count, serving as a data transfer object or entity in the web layer of a shopping application.

classes.name: ProductList
classes.description: A serializable class encapsulating a list of products and their total count, used for representing multiple products in the web layer of the application.

methods.name: setProducts
methods.description: Sets the list of ReadableProduct instances.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Returns the list of ReadableProduct instances.

methods.name: getProductCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of products.
